newsitem.title: SPAIN: Vallehermoso fixed assets revised up 9.1pct.
newsitem.headline: Vallehermoso fixed assets revised up 9.1pct.

text.p: The value of Spanish property group Vallehermoso's overall fixed assets in 1996 was revised up 9.1 percent to 239.57 billion pesetas from their 1994 value, the firm said on Thursday.
Last year, the Spanish government approved a tax break which allowed companies to update the value of their fixed assets.
After a valuation update by real estate firm Richard Ellis S.A., the value of Vallehermoso's rental property was revised up 13.7 percent to 134.83 billion pesetas.
The value of other assets, including land and work in progress, rose 3.7 percent to 104.73 billion pesetas.
